notes.message: This is cash and cash equivalents only. Short-term investments and marketable securities are NOT included, and at this size they are usually the larger half: at FY2025 Microsoft held $30.2B of cash against $64.3B of short-term investments, and Alphabet $30.7B against $96.1B of marketable securities. Someone asking how much money the company has on hand is being shown roughly a third of it.
